impact.com is a commerce partnership marketing platform that enables businesses to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the customer journey. The Associate Software Engineer will develop, test, and maintain platform software, collaborate with distributed Agile teams, support platform health through triage and bug fixes, and grow expertise in the technologies used by the squad.

Responsibilities
Develop & Maintain: Write clean, maintainable code for the impact.com platform, working both independently and while pair programming with senior engineers
Build & Test: Create meaningful unit, functional, and integration tests to ensure the quality and reliability of your software. You’ll also assist our QA team with testing in staging environments and fixing broken builds
Collaborate & Deliver: Actively participate in an Agile/Scrum environment, collaborating with a distributed team of engineers, product managers, and designers to fulfill the squad's quarterly objectives
Triage & Support: Play a crucial role in maintaining platform health by performing triage, verifying bug reports, and implementing fixes
Learn & Grow: Become an expert in the technologies used by your squad and help onboard new team members
